lane_surface.definition: S_pct = pct_rank(accumulated spring-pair strike votes); see gems/springalign.py
lane_surface.bands: pinned GDR wellspring CSV (temp_c>=40C hot points); no training band
lane_surface.implementation: gems/springalign.py (pair segments 10-60px, 25% extension cap 15px, vote sqrt(Ti*Tj)/100)
lane_surface.catalogue_use: none in S, keep ranking or refill weight; inherited d_cat>2.0px exclusion only

far_candidate_pool.rule: footprint AND valid topography AND d_cat>2.0px AND d_H19>3.0px AND not in R0; scan restricted to top-400k by S_raw

lane_surface.keep_rule: exact expected-DTI greedy (alpha 0.2 beta 0.8 R=3px) over R0 pixels only, w=0.30+0.70*S_pct on H19-5 support
lane_surface.refill_rule: spaced top-S: descending S_raw, 2.8px strict spacing floor (gems.springalign.spaced_top_mask) -- the emission rule exercised by the pre-build screen
lane_surface.uniqueness_by_construction: R0 and D2.8/SOLO are subsets of H19-5 (asserted in build); far dots are >3px from every H19-5 pixel, so whole-file fraction within 3px of any lineage raster equals the kept fraction (0.67/0.62/0.55) up to skeleton-adjacency of kept dots themselves, which is exact-shared only against R0. Measured against all local registry rasters in evidence/springalign_proxy_audit.json.
